insight: The cave man knew: fire dog art burial cooking drums stories stars herbs flint. He knew everything essential. We just forgot and remembered in different shapes. dogBark is the first friend (40000 BCE wolf chose us). songBird sings the dawn. skunkBat watches the night. Every human culture IS an ecosystem. Every city IS a coral reef. Every tool IS an organism extending its body. Anthropology IS ecology because humans ARE organisms.
title: Anthropology IS Ecology — Beast Friends Forever
